description: Tests tumor identity, amended pathology precedence, partial TNM evidence, and treatment intent.

documents.text: History of left breast invasive ductal carcinoma, ER positive, treated with lumpectomy and adjuvant radiation.
New 2.1 cm right upper lobe pulmonary lesion, suspicious for primary lung malignancy or metastasis. No enlarged mediastinal nodes.
Right lung biopsy: carcinoma, preliminary morphology favors lung primary. Immunostains pending.
Right lung biopsy: adenocarcinoma. Initial immunophenotype interpretation favors lung origin.
Amended diagnosis: metastatic carcinoma consistent with breast primary. Tumor is GATA3 positive, ER positive, TTF-1 negative. This amendment replaces the prior interpretation of lung primary.
Reviewed amended pathology with patient. Pulmonary lesion represents metastatic recurrence of breast cancer. Plan systemic endocrine therapy with palliative disease-control intent.
Fulvestrant initiated for metastatic breast carcinoma.
